predecessorObligations.note: Required W04/W05 cash/provider recovery and W06 Wallet/Subscription/privacy acceptance are prerequisites; this packet does not replace or claim their execution.

fullLaunchRule: Every required function must have traceable real acceptance or accountable full-launch blocker. No silently optional provider, subscription feature or report. Conditional D01..D04 need authoritative inventory decisions before implementation and measurement.

cases.name: catalog-authorization
cases.stimulus: Publish incompatible or unauthorized service/add-on definitions and retry a valid CAS update.
cases.requiredAssertions: Owner validation rejects invalid combinations; stale revisions conflict; history/audit/outbox retain only the valid transition.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: quote-money
cases.stimulus: Request approved vehicle/package/add-on combinations including included duplicate extras and currency boundaries.
cases.requiredAssertions: Server totals/discount/fees/taxes/duration follow approved versioned policy; no floating rounding, unapproved currency or duplicate charge; copied browser total has no authority.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: quote-expiry-retirement
cases.stimulus: Admit an old quote, publish/retire prices, cross exact effective and expiry boundaries and retry.
cases.requiredAssertions: Historical snapshots remain immutable; admission and retirement behavior matches approved policy; only newly eligible quotes use current prices; expired quotes cannot create a new operation.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: price-final-publication-race
cases.stimulus: Race two independent admin sessions to publish conflicting versions from the same expected revision.
cases.requiredAssertions: One permitted publication wins or the accepted overlap policy applies transactionally; losing command returns conflict; replay returns durable result; no overlapping eligible prices.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: price-forbidden-current-role
cases.stimulus: Attempt create/review/publish/retire without the exact grant, after revocation and across tenant/object scope.
cases.requiredAssertions: Current owner authorization rejects every prohibited command and unauthorized historical read; audit records allowed/denied policy evidence without sensitive payload leakage.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: price-effective-boundaries
cases.stimulus: Use real D create/review/publish/retire actions around start/end instants then fetch A quotes and old bookings.
cases.requiredAssertions: Approved UTC boundary semantics, CAS and separation-of-duty policy hold; only new eligible quotes change; old receipts/bookings remain byte-equivalent in their immutable financial fields.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: promotion-windows-applicability
cases.stimulus: Exercise exact start/end, excluded service/add-on/region/vehicle, retired version and unauthorized coupon access.
cases.requiredAssertions: Pricing uses approved applicability/window policy and server clock; invalid or unavailable promotion is refused without consuming budget.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: promotion-stack-benefit-order
cases.stimulus: Combine two promotions and entitlement coverage including equal-precedence choices and a policy-disallowed mix.
cases.requiredAssertions: Accepted deterministic precedence/allocation is recorded in one immutable quote; disallowed combinations reject; entitlement funding is not subtracted twice and refund basis remains reconcilable.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: coupon-last-redemption-race
cases.stimulus: Synchronize separate DB connections reserving the final global coupon use.
cases.requiredAssertions: Real transactional counters/constraints admit at most the remaining count; losers have no durable benefit; commit/release retries preserve counts and event identity.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: coupon-budget-race
cases.stimulus: Race distinct commands against the remaining approved money budget and customer cap.
cases.requiredAssertions: Reserved plus committed exposure never exceeds each limit; canonical discount reservation is bound to quote; no negative counter or stale-read overspend.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: coupon-unknown-expiry
cases.stimulus: Pause commit after durable claim, lose response, let lease/quote TTL expire and deliver stale release.
cases.requiredAssertions: UNKNOWN claimed exposure remains unavailable; expiry does not restore capacity; fence prevents a late commit after definitive noncommit release; recovery finds one terminal effect.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: guest-limit-ownership
cases.stimulus: Repeat redemptions from authorized guest contexts and replay/cross-use another guest beneficiary after conversion or token expiry.
cases.requiredAssertions: Accepted guest identity/window/linking policy limits each authoritative beneficiary; browser/device identifiers cannot create extra uses; object-level authorization and privacy minimize identifiers.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: promotion-cancel-restoration-race
cases.stimulus: Race cancellation, committed redemption, refund status, duplicate restore with distinct keys and late workers.
cases.requiredAssertions: Only approved fenced restoration applies once by original redemption/correction identity; money refund, entitlement correction and coupon headroom remain independent; pending refund never restores capacity.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: rebook-current-price
cases.stimulus: Rebook a completed booking after price/catalog/availability changes through the preserved customer flow.
cases.requiredAssertions: New authorized intent and current quote are required; changed price is visible before explicit confirmation; old quote/receipt unchanged; C independently revalidates capacity.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: rebook-spent-resources
cases.stimulus: Rebook using an expired quote, consumed entitlement, consumed Wallet hold or committed coupon reservation as old context.
cases.requiredAssertions: Old resources cannot implicitly authorize the new operation; new reservations validate current eligible balances/benefits/caps; no second spend or duplicated old discount.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: rebook-compensation-no-capacity-resurrection
cases.stimulus: Expire new capacity while a finance outcome is UNKNOWN, then deliver verified late payment.
cases.requiredAssertions: C retains closed capacity state, obtains authoritative same-operation outcome and routes explicit approved compensation; financial receipt cannot resurrect the booking.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: ledger-runtime-immutability
cases.stimulus: Upgrade from accepted predecessor, test unbalanced/duplicate references, attempt runtime UPDATE/DELETE and rerun E provisioning.
cases.requiredAssertions: SQL rejects unbalanced/duplicate or unauthorized writes; posted history remains immutable after reprovisioning; approved corrections append linked balanced postings; no cross-owner DB access.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: cash-three-facts
cases.stimulus: Complete work, issue authorized cash receipt, then record custodian company handover with offline duplicate delivery.
cases.requiredAssertions: Work completion, customer money receipt and company settlement remain separate facts; one receipt and one linked custody movement; customer service value never becomes invented technician earnings.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: cash-discrepancy-approval
cases.stimulus: Record amount mismatch and request audited disposition using stale/forbidden approvals and duplicate requests.
cases.requiredAssertions: Approved custody/discrepancy policy and current authority hold; discrepancy remains traceable; adjustments post once without editing original receipt or account balance.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: provider-shamcash-genuine
cases.stimulus: Run required accepted ShamCash route with genuine merchant/test references, proof access and signed/authorized verification.
cases.requiredAssertions: Validated recipient/reference/amount/currency/ownership and provider capability evidence precede payment confirmation; demo QR/proof image alone never closes acceptance; exactly-once durable reconciliation.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: provider-syriatelcash-genuine
cases.stimulus: Run required accepted SyriatelCash route including genuine failure/pending and retry evidence.
cases.requiredAssertions: Required approved verification and recipient/reference/amount/currency/ownership checks hold; no invented webhook or API capability; missing provider evidence remains full-launch blocker.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: provider-paymera-decision
cases.stimulus: Resolve B-02 required Paymera scope against approved inventory and genuine provider acceptance documentation.
cases.requiredAssertions: Accountable signed scope decision is recorded; if required, the genuine end-to-end route and failures pass; absence is neither silently omitted nor converted into a fourth UI method.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: proof-current-object-authority
cases.stimulus: Upload/read a private proof, revoke actor/session/object access, then attempt verification and export from another subject.
cases.requiredAssertions: Every later access and financial command revalidates current authority; no public media shortcut; proof is review evidence, never money receipt; exports redact foreign proofs.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: refund-partial-cap-race
cases.stimulus: Race distinct partial/full refund keys against one verified allocation while entitlement consumption is attempted.
cases.requiredAssertions: Refund claims plus terminal refunds cannot exceed approved refundable amount; owner adjustment fence prevents benefit-use/refund double value; currency and original posting lineage match; losing request has no monetary effect.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: refund-unknown-provider-response
cases.stimulus: Crash after provider or Billing effect before reply, retry and deliver duplicate/out-of-order callbacks.
cases.requiredAssertions: Same business operation resolves original result once; pending/UNKNOWN reserve remains claimed; no repeated refund/credit/benefit restoration; provider noncommit proof fences late execution before release.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: provider-settlement-discrepancy
cases.stimulus: Reconcile genuine provider settlement batches with missing/duplicate/mismatched records and reordered financial events.
cases.requiredAssertions: Original verification and settlement facts are distinct; mismatches remain actionable and linked; D can recompute source totals/revisions and sees explicit gaps rather than invented zero/complete counts.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: wallet-holder-final-funds
cases.stimulus: Race approved holders reserving the final backed funds and attempt unsupported holder/purpose/funding route.
cases.requiredAssertions: Eligible available funds stay nonnegative and reconcile verified Billing references; forbidden ownership/purpose is rejected; no customer stored-value product is inferred from internal custody.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: wallet-capture-claim-restart
cases.stimulus: Claim durable capture, commit Billing, lose reply, restart Wallet and expire local hold before original result lookup.
cases.requiredAssertions: Claimed funds stay unavailable throughout UNKNOWN; recovery links one original posting; stale lease/revocation cannot release exposure or allow a duplicate capture.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: wallet-no-effect-release-contract
cases.stimulus: Try to release an unposted hold through historical wallet.hold-resolve.v1, then use the separately accepted no-effect release protocol.
cases.requiredAssertions: Existing required nonempty posting IDs remain strict; no fake posting is created; only new accepted terminal-authority/fence contract can release definitively unused funds.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: wallet-refund-route-once
cases.stimulus: Request refund to approved and unapproved holders/purposes, lose Wallet-credit response and retry with new keys.
cases.requiredAssertions: Approved destination ownership/policy and exact original-refund lineage hold; one credit per Billing refund posting; no second ledger or alternate destination credited on retry.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: subscription-plan-activation
cases.stimulus: Create approved customer plan versions, verify activation allocation and retry pending/rejected payment.
cases.requiredAssertions: Only verified eligible Billing allocation activates one term; published plan benefits/price snapshot persist; illustrative plan rates are never accepted commercial inputs.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: subscription-renewal-isolation
cases.stimulus: Lose renewal reply, fail payment or deliver duplicates while a prior valid term exists.
cases.requiredAssertions: Renewal attempt and prior term remain distinct; original accepted activation occurs once; no auto recurring debit or booking implied; expiry boundary follows approved policy.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: subscription-final-unit-race
cases.stimulus: Race final-unit reserve, consume, release and expiry with late workers across separate transactions.
cases.requiredAssertions: One approved terminal effect wins per stable reservation; no double consume/negative remaining unit; consumed history never becomes a release and UNKNOWN claimed units are not made reusable.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: subscription-plan-adjustment-history
cases.stimulus: Apply approved plan-change/proration and consumed-benefit reversal with duplicate or stale revisions.
cases.requiredAssertions: Approved eligibility/valuation/refund cap follows immutable old/new plan and posting lineage; original consumption stays in history; independent correction receipts prevent repeated restoration.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: statement-receipt-current-auth
cases.stimulus: Read paginated owner statements and historical receipts as subject/operator/admin after role revocation and across objects.
cases.requiredAssertions: Current authorization and approved redaction hold for every page/download; snapshots and totals reconcile original postings; broad billing.read is not assumed sufficient for private owner records.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: support-remedy-scope
cases.stimulus: Invoke approved remedy from a genuine authorized dispute with stale state, forbidden grants and duplicate resolution.
cases.requiredAssertions: Support owns case state; B owner independently validates remedy authority and operation binding; one financial/benefit/coupon effect occurs; no Support or admin direct DB mutation.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: event-crash-gap-reconcile
cases.stimulus: Crash before/after outbox commit, inbox effect and ACK, reorder revisions and replay beyond transport retention.
cases.requiredAssertions: Local business/audit/outbox commit atomically; inbox/hash/effect/checkpoint commit before ACK; durable business dedup survives replay cache; D detects holes/rebuilds from scoped owner history without global-order assumption.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: final-status-three-app
cases.stimulus: Lose command response and reconnect customer/operator/admin during RESERVED/PENDING/UNKNOWN/rejected/terminal outcomes.
cases.requiredAssertions: Accepted separate resource/finance status and safe same-operation lookup appear in each app; timeout is not failure and proof navigation not payment; no new key issued before original outcome resolution.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: privacy-export-authorization
cases.stimulus: Create approved export task, cross-use request/subject/owner, revoke current permission and retry artifact delivery.
cases.requiredAssertions: Accepted request/subject/owner and current authorization are checked at execution and each private access; only approved classes export; durable outcome and artifact references leak no foreign data.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: privacy-anonymize-retain
cases.stimulus: Run approved anonymization/retention actions with ledger exceptions, pending finance disputes and stale worker retry.
cases.requiredAssertions: Approved class/action policy anonymizes allowed fields/copies/indexes/artifacts and reports each retained exception truthfully; posted ledger and required lineage preserved; requested deletion is never reported as completed global erasure.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: privacy-terminal-recovery
cases.stimulus: Crash after owner fulfillment before completion reply; revoke task authority and redeliver cancellation/completion out of order.
cases.requiredAssertions: Durable per-owner status/audit reconciles original authorized result; no repeated destructive effect or unauthorized resumption; intake acceptance is separate from terminal fulfillment.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: three-app-full-matrix
cases.stimulus: Execute cash and every required electronic route, approved Wallet use, Subscription activation/renew/consume/refund, promotion/rebook and admin reconciliation on latest target plus head.
cases.requiredAssertions: Each real producer and full journey passes before consumer integration acceptance; exact source/tree/run/attempt and provider artifacts bind all cases; missing merchant/policy input is explicit NO-GO, never a mock-backed pass.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: design-prod-state-boundaries
cases.stimulus: Execute affected approved Arabic seven-step/guest/optional-plate and admin/operator actions with error, motion and reconnect states.
cases.requiredAssertions: Frozen golden references/tolerances unchanged; real affected flows have exact reference/candidate/diff and accessibility evidence; unapproved English/production states require owner decision; device evidence is separate.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: workload-provenance
cases.stimulus: Collect owner command/event rates, mixes, retained volumes and latency windows under allocated resources after real providers exist.
cases.requiredAssertions: Inputs name environment/source/policy/data/sample window/units and method; measured observations remain distinct from approved targets and fixtures; absent measurements stay NOT_MEASURED.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent

cases.name: base-role-contract-provider-gates
cases.stimulus: Publish actual wave base/contracts/grants/routes/clients and run provider migration/current-auth/constraints/conformance before consumers.
cases.requiredAssertions: Exact accepted versions and current isolated DB identities are recorded; no private DTO/model/DB import or moving peer branch; latest-target candidate and resulting-target checks remain required.
blockers: BASE_W07 and accepted owner contracts absent
